label: Minimax_H3_Image_Edit
notes: workflow.json is the source of truth from here on (Harry continues from it). Source: the ComfyUI gallery template image_minimax_h3_image_edit (free, local), fetched with comfy-mcp on 2026-11-15 and converted to API format by comfy-cli (`comfy run --print-prompt`). Same checkpoint, encoder, VAE and prompt expander as minimax_h3_image_t2i.

Retitles: Save Image (9) -> nuke_save; Text (user_prompt) (43) -> nuke_prompt; KSampler (38) -> nuke_ksampler; Generate Text (34) -> nuke_generate_text; Boolean (Enable PE?) (61) -> nuke_enhance; Load Diffusion Model (29) -> nuke_load_diffusion_model; Load CLIP 32B (30) -> nuke_load_text_encoder; MiniMax H3 Image Conditioning (32) -> nuke_conditioning; Load Image (45) -> nuke_input_1.

Added Load Image nodes 102-116 titled nuke_input_2 ... nuke_input_16 (MiniMax's model card: up to 16 reference images), each wired to images.image_N on nuke_conditioning and images.imageN on nuke_generate_text, as the template's own note says to add more. Nuke prunes the ones not plugged in.

nuke_input_1 is wired straight into both nodes too (agreed with Harry on 2026-11-15). The template sent it through Resize to exactly 4 MP (56), Resize to a multiple of 32 (48, which floors and centre-crops), Get Image Size (50) and Compare Images (62); all four are deleted. With the output size bound to Nuke's, that chain made the reference a different shape from the output (2752x1536 became 2720x1504, about 1% cropped off y), so every edit came back about 2% taller, compounding when results were fed back in. Nuke already sends img1 at exactly the generation size on the 32 grid, which the conditioning node passes through unchanged.
Width and height are bound on nuke_conditioning, so the output size follows the Nuke format (by default the first input's). In workflow.json they are 0, the node's 'use image_1's size'.

Harry generated with one and with two input images from the Nuke GUI on 2026-11-15, before the rewiring of nuke_input_1 (those showed the stretch), and again after it: chained edits now keep their proportions.

knobs.name: model
knobs.tooltip: Diffusion model file: the MiniMax H3 Image models installed in ComfyUI. Variants differ in precision (int8, bf16, w4a8 ...): higher precision is better quality but needs more VRAM and time.

knobs.name: text_encoder
knobs.label: text encoder
knobs.tooltip: The Qwen3-VL 32B model that reads the prompt and the input images. int8 is the template's choice; nvfp4 is smaller and may cost some accuracy.

knobs.name: enhance
knobs.label: enhance prompt
knobs.tooltip: Expand the edit instruction into a detailed one with the Qwen 3.5 LLM, which also looks at the input images. Slower; the expanded text appears in 'used prompt'. Refer to inputs as <Picture 1> (img1, the image being edited), <Picture 2> ...

knobs.name: steps
knobs.tooltip: Sampling steps. The model is distilled for 6.
